info.description:
Generated by Reinvent (`./trigger export`) from payloads/scenario.json. Don't edit by hand; re-export.

This collection contains no keys. 

1. Paste your keys into the collection variables: `orchestration_routing_key` and each `change_key_*` (each variable says where to find it). EU accounts: set `events_url` to https://events.eu.pagerduty.com.
2. Run the folder **1. Run the demo** with the Collection Runner. The requests keep the demo's pacing themselves.
3. When you're done, run **2. Resolve the demo**. It resolves the most recent run.
info.name: Reinvent: payment-api memory leak

item.description: Every event in order, about 30 seconds in the Collection Runner.

exec: // New run ID: every alert's dedup_key ends in it, so each run opens fresh incidents.
pm.collectionVariables.set("run_id", "run-" + Date.now().toString(36));
pm.variables.set("s01_ts1", new Date(Date.now() - 180 * 60000).toISOString()); // 180 minutes ago
pm.test("PagerDuty accepted the event (202)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });

// Keep the demo's pacing in the Collection Runner.
setTimeout(function () {}, 2000);

{

  "dedup_key": "reinvent/payments/payment-api/memory-leak/{{run_id}}",
  "event_action": "trigger",
  "links": [
    {
      "href": "https://grafana.example-payments.internal/d/k8s-pod?var-pod=payment-api",
      "text": "Grafana: pod memory"
    }
  ],
  "payload": {
    "class": "memory_leak",
    "component": "payment-api",
    "custom_details": {
      "alertname": "KubePodMemoryNearNodeAllocatable",
      "cluster": "eks-sre-demo",
      "co_located_workloads": "payments-portal, checkout (same node)",
      "container": "app",
      "container_memory_working_set": "7.4Gi",
      "deployment": "payment-api",
      "image": "registry.internal/payments/payment-api:v2.14.0",
      "memory_limit": "none (resources.limits.memory not set)",
      "memory_trend": "linear growth of ~150Mi/min since rollout of v2.14.0 47m ago; flat at ~600Mi on v2.13.4",
      "namespace": "payments",
      "node": "ip-10-0-12-34.ap-southeast-2.compute.internal",
      "node_allocatable_memory": "7.7Gi",
      "platform": "kubernetes",
      "pod_selector": "app=payment-api",
      "process_state": "card authorisation worker thread blocked; heartbeat last seen 4m ago; pod still Running and Ready=False",
      "restarts": 0,
      "service": "payment-api",
      "suspected_change": "iso8583-codec 3.4.2 → 4.0.0 shipped in v2.14.0"
    },
    "group": "payments",
    "severity": "critical",
    "source": "ip-10-0-12-34.ap-southeast-2.compute.internal",
    "summary": "Kubernetes: payment-api pod memory at 96% of node allocatable and authorisation worker hung (no heartbeat 4m) on ip-10-0-12-34.ap-southeast-2.compute.internal"

}

{

    },
    "group": "payments-platform",
    "severity": "error",
    "source": "splunk-search:payments-errors-10m",
    "summary": "Splunk: payment-api error log spike, 2,140 ISO8583DecodeException \"message buffer pool exhausted\" in 10m (baseline 3)"
  },
  "routing_key": "{{orchestration_routing_key}}"
}
